name: BorisTheBrave/DeBroglie
description: A C# library implementing Wave Function Collapse with full backtracking support, additional non-local constraints, and NuGet distribution for easy integration. Designed for production use in game pipelines where vanilla WFC would fail to resolve contradictions.
score_rationale: The most production-ready WFC library for .NET/Unity with constraint extensions and active documentation that vanilla WFC lacks.
summary: Production-ready WFC library for .NET/Unity with backtracking and constraint support.
